purpose: Provide a deterministic persistent continuity shell for an external authorized runner without claiming that the runner is already live.
hard_invariants: P_base and formal authority are read-only to this runtime candidate.
real_5min_runtime_live remains false until real authorized always-on execution evidence and formal promotion exist.
No per-pulse durable log; durable state and evidence remain bounded.
Recovery is two-stage: prepare_recovery then mark_recovery_verified.
A recovery attempt is not a verified recovery.
Scheduled task last_run is not durable progress.
New runtime failure rolls back only this candidate delta and never invalidates Step001-009 verified baseline without exact regression evidence.
evidence_required_for_real_live: An authorized external runner actually invokes the runtime at sub-hour cadence.
Observed 300-second heartbeat cadence with durable timestamps.
At least one real interruption followed by a recovery attempt within 300 seconds.
Recovery must be independently verified, not self-declared by the candidate.
20-minute work-lifecycle continuity must show durable progress or an explicit bounded recovery path.
Restart/outage must recover from persisted cursor/state without Experience contamination.
C verifier must bind exact current artifacts and evidence before any live promotion.
phase0_acceptance: W02/W03/W04 adversarial reviews have no unreleased veto
incident replay includes the 2026-08-17 W01 midstream-window recovery incident
forbidden_claims: Scheduled Tasks equals a real five-minute runner
